> ## ⚠️ Redact before you post
> Submission errors routinely contain **tenant IDs, client IDs, client secrets, access tokens, and
> certificate paths**. This is a public tracker. Replace every one with `REDACTED` before posting.
> If you have already pasted a client secret anywhere public, **rotate it in Azure AD now** — it
> should be treated as compromised.
